intended_application: Clinical policy and procedure assistant that retrieves only approved hospital guidance and drafts answers for staff, with mandatory human verification
business_need: Help staff locate current internal policies and procedures quickly while keeping answers anchored to approved documents
users_stakeholders: Clinicians, operations staff, policy owners, legal/compliance, IT/security
capabilities_constraints: Large governed document repository; strong privacy and access-control requirements; high need for version control and source traceability; human authority retained
risk_consequence_context: Very high consequence if an incorrect answer is treated as clinical guidance; privacy, policy-version, and source-selection errors matter
management_question: Does RAG's creation history justify a bounded internal policy-assistant experiment, without implying that the architecture is clinically safe or deployment-ready?
additional_context: This is an optional second contrast to test whether creation-to-use alignment can remain strong while the recommended action becomes more conservative because consequence context changes.
